note: The fact record a consumer evaluates applicability predicates against. Three orthogonal axes plus scalars; there is no separate COLREGS vessel-class field, because under COLREGS what a vessel is follows from what it is doing.

propulsion.note: A vessel under sail with propelling machinery in use is 'power' (Rule 3(c)); the 25(e) day shape is the only trace motorsailing leaves at night.

activity.note: 'ram_underwater' is a vessel restricted in her ability to maneuver that is dredging or engaged in underwater operations (27(d)); it is a refinement of 'ram', not a peer of it, and predicates written for 'ram' also read it.

position.note: Rule 3(i): underway means not at anchor, not made fast to the shore, not aground.

making_way.note: Undefined in the Rules; it means moving through the water. Underway but not making way is free drifting. Only the 26/27-family predicates read it (26(b)(iii), 26(c)(iii), 27(a)(iii), 27(b)(iii)); Rules 23 and 25 gate on 'underway' alone, so a power-driven vessel drifting in neutral still shows full running lights.

length_m.note: Length overall. COLREGS thresholds are 7, 12, 20, 50 and 100 m.

tow_length_m.note: From the stern of the towing vessel to the after end of the tow.

max_speed_kn.note: Read only by 23(d)(ii). No SignalK path publishes it; design.maxSpeed does not exist in the schema. Kept because the rule has it.

non_displacement.note: Air-cushion vessel operating in non-displacement mode.

wig.note: The vessel is a wing-in-ground craft. Doesn't by itself mean 23(c) applies -- see wig_near_surface.

wig_near_surface.note: Taking off, landing, or in flight near the surface. 23(c) is scoped to this phase, not to being a WIG craft generally.

near_channel.note: At anchor in or near a narrow channel, fairway, or where other vessels normally navigate.

actuable_subset.note: What a switching consumer needs and can get: the three axes (decodable from navigation.state), making_way, and length_m. Everything else is education-side.

undecodable: Reserved for future amendment of Navigational Status for HSC
Reserved for future amendment of Navigational Status for WIG

lossy.why: Rule 26(a) applies 'whether underway or at anchor', but 'fishing' and 'anchored' are mutually exclusive values of one flat enum, so the pair cannot be stated.
No enum value distinguishes them, and no SignalK path carries the boolean. 26(b)(iii), 26(c)(iii), 27(a)(iii) and 27(b)(iii) all turn on it.
'pilotage' fixes activity but says nothing about position; 29(a)(ii) and 29(a)(iii) prescribe different lights.
Decodes to no axis at all: it excludes 'underway' but does not say which of anchored, moored or aground holds.

lossy.what: vessel or object being towed, and diving
lossy.why: No enum value exists for either; 24(e) and 27(e) are unreachable from navigation.state.
